Leah: Alert: suspicious BYOK import_token reuse for tenant T-881 at 2026-03-12T08:12:34Z. Token seen from two IPs within 40s. Tagging for triage. @Diego @Ravi
ops-bot: alert: hsm.import.unauth_attempt tenant=T-881 count=2 first_ts=2026-03-12T08:12:34Z link=https://alerts.redwood/6880
Diego: Revoke token immediately. Which token id?
Leah: token=imp-881-20260312-01. I triggered revoke to token-issuer.
Ravi: Revoked. Also triggered HSM audit snapshot and pulled /var/log/hsm/audit.log lines.
Priya: Legal: preserve immutable evidence in WORM, capture operator IDs, IPs, CSR fingerprints, CMK id, payload hashes and action timestamps. Notify CS for disclosure window.
Diego: Correlating CloudTrail: found ImportKeyMaterial event at 2026-03-12T08:12:34Z from ip 18.205.5.9 using role import_session. HSM shows import:start then import:abort after revoke.
Leah: Save tooling sha and exact CLI args if available. Diego, can you grab agent binary hash?
Diego: tooling_sha=sha256:7f8e9a.., args=`hsm-cli import --csr /tmp/csr.pem --token imp-881-20260312-01`. Uploaded to s3://redwood-worm/forensics/IR-3501/cli-meta.json
Ravi: Writing manifest (signed) with events, s3 artifact paths, and operator signatures. Will run `hsm-collect --snapshot` then aws s3 cp with SSE and detached sig.
Priya: Retention: 7 years WORM for this tenant per contract. Draft disclosure text: notify CS within 72h; if no key material imported, provide summary and remediation steps.
Leah: Short fixes: require single-use tokens, bind tokens to CSR fingerprint or requester IP, reduce import_session TTL to 5m, approver MFA mandatory. Samir/infra to follow up on policy.
Diego: Also add alert rule: token reuse across >1 src IP within 60s -> P1 and block IPs at edge.
Leah: Created IR ticket IR-3501 and assigned to Ravi. Follow-ups: upload signed manifest, runbook update, tabletop.
ops-bot: IR ticket IR-3501 created by @Leah assigned to @Ravi priority=P1
Leah: Thanks all.
